2.w: Do not be forgetful of hospitality, for through this, some entertained angels unawares.

3.w: Remember the prisoners as having been bound with [them], those being mistreated as yourselves also being in the body.

4.w: [Let] marriage [be] honored in all, and the marriage bed undefiled; for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

5.w: [your] manner of life [let be] without love of money, being satisfied with the present; for He Himself has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”

6.w: So we are confident to say: “The Lord [is] to me a helper, and I will not be afraid; what will man do to me?”

7.w: Remember those leading you⁺ who spoke the word of God to you⁺, of whom, considering the outcome of [their] conduct, imitate the faith.

8.w: Jesus Christ [is] the same yesterday and today and to the ages.

9.w: Do not be carried along [by] various and strange teachings; for [it is] good [for] the heart to be confirmed by grace, not by foods, in which those walking were not profited.

10.w: We have an altar from which those serving in the tabernacle have no authority to eat.

11.w: For animals whose blood is brought for sin into the holy places by the high priest—the bodies of those are burned outside the camp.

12.w: Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate. so that He might sanctify the people by [His] own blood,

13.w: Therefore we should go out to Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.

14.w: For here we do not have an abiding city, but we are seeking for the one about to be.

15.w: Through Him, then, we should offer up a sacrifice of praise through all [time] to God, that is, the fruit of lips confessing His name.

16.w: And do not be forgetful of doing good and of sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

17.w: Obey you⁺ those leading and be subject, for they watch over your⁺ souls as [those who] will give an account, so that they may do this with joy and not groaning, for this [is] unprofitable for you⁺.

18.w: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, wanting to conduct ourselves well in all things.

19.w: And more abundantly I exhort [you] to do this, so that I may be restored to you⁺ more quickly.

20.w: Now [may] the God of peace, the One having brought up out from the dead the great Shepherd of the sheep, our Lord Jesus, by the blood of the eternal covenant,

21.w: equip you⁺ in everything good in order to do His will, doing in us that which [is] well pleasing before Him, through Jesus Christ, to whom [be] the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.

22.w: Now I exhort you⁺, brothers, bear with the word of exhortation, for I have also written to you⁺ by few [words].

23.w: You⁺ know our brother Timothy has been released, with whom I will see you⁺ if he should come more quickly.

24.w: Greet all those leading you⁺ and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you⁺.
